topic: Analytics data parity between staging and production
summary_markdown: A discussion occurred regarding the consistency of analytics data used for a specific campaign. It was noted that for one mall, the data appears identical on both staging and production environments. However, for other locations, differences exist. A key decision point was established: frequency fixes from the staging environment should not be transferred to production, as the current validation on production is satisfactory.
decisions: Frequency fixes from staging will not be moved to production.
action_items: Set a placeholder/dummy value (заглушку) for the data point.
